```{r}
#Loading Dataset
setwd("C:/Users/devon/OneDrive/Senior Project")

mlb <- read.csv("stats.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")

#Basic Cleaning

mlb <- na.omit(mlb)
mlb <- mlb[!duplicated(mlb), ]

# Creating formula for wRAA to measure player performance

# scale vector (first index 2015, last index 2025) from FanGraphs: https://www.fangraphs.com/tools/guts?type=cn
wOBA_scale <- c(1.251, 1.212, 1.185, 1.226, 1.157, 1.185, 1.209, 1.259, 1.204, 1.242, 1.232)

# league average wOBA by season (first index 2015, last index 2025) from FanGraphs: https://www.fangraphs.com/leaders/major-league?pos=all&stats=bat&lg=all&qual=0&type=8&month=0&ind=0&team=0%2Css&rost=0&players=0&sort=0%2Cd&startdate=&enddate=&season1=2015&season=2025
lgwOBA <- c(.313, .318, .321, .315, .320, .320, .314, .310, .318, .310, .313)

# Using the FanGraphs formula Weighted Runs Above Average (wRAA) = ((wOBA - lgwOBA) / wOBA_scale) * PA to have a metric strictly for offensive performance

mlb$wRAA <- 0


#apply formula to all observations
for (i in 1:nrow(mlb)){
  mlb$wRAA[i]<- ((mlb$woba[i] - lgwOBA[mlb$year[i] - 2014]) / wOBA_scale[mlb$year[i] - 2014]) * mlb$pa[i]
}

#Subset Selection

swing_cols <- c(49, 50, 51, 52, 53, 56, 58, 59, 64, 67, 69, 71, 72, 73, 74, 75, 77, 78, 80, 82, 84)

for (i in swing_cols){
  mlb[ , i] <- mlb[ , i] / 100
}

swing_cols <- c(13, 17, 20, 28, 86, 49, 50, 51, 52, 53, 56, 58, 59, 64, 67, 69, 71, 72, 73, 74, 75, 77, 78, 80, 82, 84)

#subset of features only including swing decision features and potential response variables
mlb_swings <- mlb[, swing_cols]

mlb_swings$walk_percent <- mlb$walk / mlb$pa
mlb_swings$run_percent <- mlb$r_run / mlb$pa
mlb_swings <- mlb_swings[ , c(-1, -4)]


# Principal Component Analysis 
swings_scaled <- scale(mlb_swings)
pca <- prcomp(swings_scaled)
summary(pca)
plot(pca)


# Standardize helper
z <- function(x) (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)

# 1. Contact Skill (PC1-like)
mlb_swings$ContactSkill <- (
    z(mlb_swings$iz_contact_percent) +
    z(mlb_swings$oz_contact_percent) -
    z(mlb_swings$whiff_percent) -
    z(mlb_swings$z_swing_miss_percent) -
    z(mlb_swings$oz_swing_miss_percent)
) / 5

# 2. Discipline Index (PC2-like)
mlb_swings$DisciplineIndex <- (
    -z(mlb_swings$oz_swing_percent) -
    -z(mlb_swings$z_swing_percent) -
    z(mlb_swings$out_zone_percent) +
    z(mlb_swings$walk_percent)
) / 4

# 3. Elevation / Batted-Ball Shape (PC3-like)
mlb_swings$ElevationIndex <- (
    z(mlb_swings$popups_percent) +
    z(mlb_swings$walk_percent) -
    z(mlb_swings$pull_percent)
) / 3

# 4. Zone Coverage (PC4-like)
mlb_swings$ZoneCoverage <- (
    z(mlb_swings$in_zone_percent) +
    z(mlb_swings$out_zone_percent) -
    z(mlb_swings$meatball_percent)
) / 3

# 5. Spray Power (PC5-like)
mlb_swings$SprayPower <- (
    z(mlb_swings$opposite_percent) -
    z(mlb_swings$pull_percent) +
    z(mlb_swings$on_base_plus_slg)
) / 3


#Creating the 80/20 train/test split
set.seed(1)
n <- nrow(mlb_swings)
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(n), size = 0.8 * n)

train <- mlb_swings[train_idx, ]
test  <- mlb_swings[-train_idx, ]

# further sub-dataset with engineered features and response, more features could be added

sw_feats <- c(3, 27, 28, 29, 30, 31)

sw_dat <- mlb_swings[, sw_feats]

trainEng <- sw_dat[train_idx, ]
testEng  <- sw_dat[-train_idx, ]

#Regression models

spray_mod <- wRAA~SprayPower
sprayZone_mod <- wRAA~SprayPower+ZoneCoverage
sprayZoneDisc_mod <- wRAA~SprayPower+ZoneCoverage+DisciplineIndex
sprayZoneDiscElev_mod <- wRAA~SprayPower+ZoneCoverage+DisciplineIndex+ElevationIndex
engSwing_mod <- wRAA~SprayPower+ZoneCoverage+DisciplineIndex+ElevationIndex+ContactSkill


#Random Forests

library(tree)
set.seed(1)

# 1 singular decision tree with the engineered features

engSwng_tree <- tree(wRAA~., data = trainEng)

cv_overgrown <- cv.tree(engSwng_tree, FUN = prune.tree)
pruned_Swng <- prune.tree(engSwng_tree, best = 4)


library(randomForest)
#Will grow two random forests - one with all of the swing decision metrics as predictors, and one with just the engineered features. Potentially a third with a combination of both depending on how the first two perform.


# forest with only swing metrics
rf_allSwng <- randomForest(wRAA~.-on_base_plus_slg-b_lob-walk_percent-run_percent-SprayPower-ZoneCoverage-DisciplineIndex-ElevationIndex-
                             ContactSkill, data = train, mtry = 7, importance = TRUE)

#forest with only engineered features
rf_engSwng <- randomForest(wRAA~., data = trainEng, mtry = 3, importance = TRUE)

# forest with swing metrics and engineered features
rf_all <- randomForest(wRAA~.-on_base_plus_slg-b_lob-walk_percent-run_percent, data = train, mtry = 8, importance = TRUE)


# Ridge regression
library(MASS)

X <- model.matrix(wRAA ~ SprayPower + ZoneCoverage + DisciplineIndex +
                    ElevationIndex + ContactSkill, data = trainEng)[, -1]

y <- trainEng$wRAA

ridge_mod <- lm.ridge(y ~ X, lambda = seq(0, 50, 0.5))
best_lambda <- ridge_mod$lambda[which.min(ridge_mod$GCV)]

ridge_final <- lm.ridge(y ~ X, lambda = best_lambda)


ridge_predict <- function(ridge_model, newdata, formula) {
  # Build model matrix from new data
  X_new <- model.matrix(formula, newdata)[, -1]
  
  # Standardize using training means and scales stored in ridge_model
  X_scaled <- scale(X_new,
                    center = ridge_model$xm,
                    scale  = ridge_model$scale)
  
  # Compute predictions: X_scaled %*% coef + intercept
  preds <- X_scaled %*% ridge_model$coef + ridge_model$ym
  
  as.numeric(preds)
}

ridge_preds <- ridge_predict(
  ridge_model = ridge_final,
  newdata = testEng,
  formula = wRAA ~ SprayPower + ZoneCoverage + DisciplineIndex +
              ElevationIndex + ContactSkill
)

```



```{r}
library(Metrics)

evaluate_model <- function(model, train, test, response = "wRAA") {
  # predictions
  train_pred <- predict(model, newdata = train)
  test_pred  <- predict(model, newdata = test)
  
  # actuals
  y_train <- train[[response]]
  y_test  <- test[[response]]
  
  # metrics
  out <- data.frame(
    RMSE_train = rmse(y_train, train_pred),
    RMSE_test  = rmse(y_test, test_pred),
    MAE_train  = mae(y_train, train_pred),
    MAE_test   = mae(y_test, test_pred),
    R2_train   = 1 - sum((y_train - train_pred)^2) / sum((y_train - mean(y_train))^2),
    R2_test    = 1 - sum((y_test - test_pred)^2) / sum((y_test - mean(y_test))^2)
  )
  return(out)
}


eval_spray      <- evaluate_model(lm(spray_mod, trainEng), trainEng, testEng)
eval_sprayZone  <- evaluate_model(lm(sprayZone_mod, trainEng), trainEng, testEng)
eval_sprayDisc  <- evaluate_model(lm(sprayZoneDisc_mod, trainEng), trainEng, testEng)
eval_sprayAll   <- evaluate_model(lm(engSwing_mod, trainEng), trainEng, testEng)
#eval_ridge <- evaluate_model(ridge_final, trainEng, testEng)

eval_tree <- evaluate_model(pruned_Swng, trainEng, testEng)

eval_rf_allSwng <- evaluate_model(rf_allSwng, train, test)
eval_rf_engSwng <- evaluate_model(rf_engSwng, trainEng, testEng)
eval_rf_all     <- evaluate_model(rf_all, train, test)

```


```{r}
# Neural Network
library(RSNNS)
library(Metrics)

responses <- c(-1, -2, -3, -25, -26)

# Preprocess manually
train_x <- scale(train[, responses])
test_x  <- scale(
  test[, responses],
  center = attr(train_x, "scaled:center"),
  scale = attr(train_x, "scaled:scale")
)

train_y <- train$wRAA
test_y  <- test$wRAA

# Train MLP

nn <- mlp(
  x = as.matrix(train_x),
  y = train_y,
  size = c(32, 16),
  learnFunc = "Std_Backpropagation",
  learnFuncParams = c(0.005, 0.9),  # lower LR
  updateFunc = "Topological_Order",
  maxit = 800,
  linOut = TRUE,
  decay = 0.001   # regularization
)



# Predict
nn_pred <- predict(nn, as.matrix(test_x))

# Metrics
nn_rmse <- rmse(test_y, nn_pred)
nn_mae  <- mae(test_y, nn_pred)

nn_rmse
nn_mae


ridge_rmse <- rmse(testEng$wRAA, ridge_preds)
ridge_mae <- mae(testEng$wRAA, ridge_preds)
```

```{r}
# Neural Net

variable_importance_sensitivity <- function(model, X, delta = 1e-4) {
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  base_pred <- predict(model, X)

  p <- ncol(X)
  importance <- numeric(p)

  for (j in 1:p) {
    X_perturbed <- X
    X_perturbed[, j] <- X_perturbed[, j] + delta

    pred_perturbed <- predict(model, X_perturbed)

    # Sensitivity = average absolute change in prediction
    importance[j] <- mean(abs(pred_perturbed - base_pred))
  }

  importance <- importance / sum(importance)

  data.frame(
    Variable = colnames(X),
    Importance = importance
  )[order(importance, decreasing = TRUE), ]
}



variable_importance_sensitivity(nn, train[, responses])
```


```{r}
#Predicted vs Actual Plots

plot_predicted_vs_actual <- function(pred, actual, model_name="Model") {
  plot(actual, pred,
     xlab = "Actual Values",
     ylab = "Predicted Values",
     main = model_name,
     pch = 19, col = "steelblue")

  abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2)   # perfect prediction line

}


#Residual Plots


plot_residuals <- function(pred, actual, model_name="Model") {
  res <- actual - pred
  
  par(mfrow=c(1,2))
  
  plot(pred, res,
       main=paste(model_name, "- Residuals vs Fitted"),
       xlab="Fitted Values", ylab="Residuals")
  abline(h=0, col="red")
  
  qqnorm(res, main=paste(model_name, "- Residual Q-Q"))
  qqline(res, col="red")
  
  par(mfrow=c(1,1))
}


lm_preds <- predict.lm(lm(engSwing_mod, trainEng), newdata = testEng)
rf_allSwng_preds <- predict(rf_allSwng, newdata = test)
rf_engSwng_preds<- predict(rf_engSwng, newdata = testEng)
rf_all_preds <- predict(rf_all, newdata = test)
nn_preds <- predict(nn, newdata = test[, responses])
```
